lessons.title: Dụng cụ và dịch vụ làm móng
lessons.objective: Gọi tên dụng cụ và các dịch vụ cơ bản trong tiệm nail.
lessons.reading: Welcome to our nail salon. We do manicures and pedicures. I use a nail file to shape the nails and a buffer to make them smooth. I push back the cuticles with a cuticle pusher. Then I paint the nails with a base coat, two coats of colour and a top coat. We also do gel nails and acrylic nails.

vocabulary.example: Would you like a manicure today?
A pedicure takes about forty-five minutes.
I use a nail file to shape your nails.
I will push back your cuticles.
The top coat makes the colour last longer.
Please choose a polish colour.

grammar.title: Câu mệnh lệnh lịch sự (Please + động từ)
grammar.explanation: Dùng động từ nguyên mẫu để hướng dẫn khách, thêm 'please' cho lịch sự.
examples: Please sit here.
Please choose a colour.
Please put your hand on the towel.

pronunciation.focus: Âm /ɪ/ và /iː/: manicure, pedicure, polish, please
pronunciation.tip: Chữ 'i' trong polish đọc ngắn /ɪ/; please đọc dài /iː/. Đừng đọc 'po-lít'.

lessons.reading: We clean and disinfect all metal tools after every customer. We use new files and buffers for each person. The pedicure tubs are cleaned with disinfectant and we use liners. lessons.objective: Mô tả quy trình đắp móng và hướng dẫn chăm sóc tại nhà.
lessons.reading: For acrylic nails, I first prepare the natural nail and apply a primer. Then I attach a tip to extend the length and mix liquid and powder to build the nail. After it hardens, I file it into shape and buff the surface. Aftercare is important: wear gloves when you clean, don't use your nails as tools, and come back for a fill every two to three weeks.

Customer: Other salons do it all the time.

lessons.title: Đàm phán hợp đồng thuê mặt bằng khi mở rộng
lessons.objective: Thương lượng điều khoản thuê, quyền chấm dứt sớm và thời gian miễn tiền thuê.
lessons.reading:
Owner: Before we proceed, there are a few clauses in the draft lease I'd like to discuss. Firstly, the break option: as it stands, I'd be locked in for ten years with no exit.
Landlord: That's standard in this building. The investment in fitting out the unit is considerable on both sides.
Owner: I understand, but given the uncertainty in the sector, I'd need a break option at year five, subject to six months' notice.
Landlord: I might entertain that if the rent review remained upward-only.
Owner: I'd resist that. If we were to accept an upward-only review, we'd want a cap tied to inflation. Furthermore, I'd expect a rent-free period of three months to cover the fit-out.
Landlord: Let me take this to my solicitor. I'll come back to you with a counter-proposal by Monday.
